reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001029 (the melody read from 001029a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Martin Luther's dates (1483–1546) are from our page for the tune AUS TIEFER NOT (LUTHER) (content/hymns/tunes/aus-tiefer-not-luther.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1535. Valentin Schumann has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1539, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). Johann Sebastian Bach's dates (1685–1750) are from our page for the tune POTSDAM (content/hymns/tunes/potsdam.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1734. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001029a.nwc).
